title: Named-street override WIRING: DB-023 hardening (binding preconditions) then provider/engine integration of the accepted matcher + DB-021 provider ceilings + DB-025(a-d) display gating
objective: Close DB-023 (a)-(c) inside the matcher FIRST (structural refusal of matched_override on unresolved qualifiers or digest-covered structured fields; construction-time validation of provision_id/section_anchor failing closed; bounded raw-query reprs) plus advisory (d) word-boundary anchoring; then wire named_street_override into the wide-street attestation seam so exceptions_checked can become True ONLY when every candidate segment resolves NOT_MATCHED with fully-resolved inputs - MATCHED_OVERRIDE and INDETERMINATE stay professional-review refusals carrying distinct override provenance; add DB-021 provider ceilings (a: provider-side MAX_LOT_VERTICES pre-check, b: wide_object_ids cap pre-fetch, c: two-layer exceptions-attestation docstring, e: untested-branch coverage); gate DevelopmentLimits/CalculationEvidence/ReportView uniformly on determination_state with the DB-025(a-c) display corrections
business_reason: DB-010 wiring is the step that lets the product honestly attest named-street exceptions were checked near Broadway W94-97 and Allen St instead of always refusing; DB-023 is the G5-ruled precondition before the matcher gains its first consumer
inputs: CHECKPOINT ENVELOPE (binding; two S4.5 stops proved this): in every checkpoint, OMIT the four envelope fields (branch, worktree, starting_sha, current_sha) entirely - the controller fills the authoritative values itself. If you do supply one, it must match EXACTLY full-length: 40-hex SHAs from `git rev-parse HEAD` (never --short), the FULL worktree path. Any abbreviated value stops the run.

COMMAND CWD (binding; the rules/api suites do NOT collect from repo root - known invocation artifact): run the first four documented commands from the services/api directory (plain `cd services/api` first; the Bash tool keeps the working directory between commands; `cd ../..` before the modularity check, which runs from the repo root). Never chain commands onto a documented command.

CODE-GRAPH NAVIGATION BLOCK (D-066-R001; regenerated 2026-09-18 at the M5-T040/T041 contract seam, HEAD 198c24f8). Run `python tools/code_graph/query.py --no-regen impact <path>` BEFORE broad sweeps; graph is ADVISORY - verify every material conclusion in source. Impact set for this packet: wide_street_wiring.py is imported by integration.py (:56, :514-520), api/v1/rule_evaluation.py:74, spatial/wide_street_live_provider.py:100, and the suites test_rule_evaluation_api/test_rules_integration/test_wide_street_wiring; the provider is imported by api/v1/rule_evaluation.py:67 + its suites. named_street_override.py is currently a LEAF (only its own test imports it) - THIS packet creates its first consumer, which is exactly why DB-023 must close first. Any attestation-behavior change is visible to tests/api and tests/rules/test_rules_integration.py - both in allowed_paths and they MUST be green.

ORDER OF WORK (binding): (1) DB-023 FIRST - close the matcher hardening cluster before any consumer import lands (G5 M1 ruling, DISCOVERY_BACKLOG DB-023): (a) disposition_when_located is outside the digest cover - fix STRUCTURALLY (refuse matched_override whenever the row carries an unresolved qualifier) or digest-cover the structured fields; (b) validate block provision_id/section_anchor at construction, failing CLOSED on a malformed snapshot (today a KeyError escapes at match()); (c) bound the raw-query reprs in MatchResult.reason before wiring to user-reachable input; (d) advisory - word-boundary anchoring in _anchored_in (G3 A1). (2) DB-021 provider hardening: (a) provider-side MAX_LOT_VERTICES check before its own first canonical_to_shapely (~:282); (b) cap wide_object_ids before the geometry-fetch loop (the engine's 512 ceiling runs only after fetch); (c) docstring note on the two-layer ZR 12-10 exceptions attestation (width-policy 'checked' vs EC-5 'unattested'; the legal half stays in the G6 queue with DB-011); (e) direct tests for the segment_geometry_unexpected_error and _attested_lot sub-branches. (3) WIRING: integrate named_street_override into the named-street attestation seam (wide_street_wiring.NamedStreetOverrideStatus / _elevated_exceptions_checked and the provider's construction of that status).

WIRING SEMANTICS (binding, fail-closed; D-051 - this packet's fallback direction is refusal-to-professional-review, never a silent narrow/wide guess): exceptions_checked may become True ONLY when the matcher returns NOT_MATCHED for EVERY candidate segment with fully-resolved typed inputs (borough/CD + street name + cross-street bounds all present and normalized). MATCHED_OVERRIDE = professional-review-class refusal carrying the distinct override provenance (snapshot sha256, section anchor, provision id, verbatim matched row). INDETERMINATE, or ANY missing/unresolvable matcher input = the existing refusal stands unchanged. NEVER apply an alternate-width value numerically - the C5-3/C6-4/C6-6 alternate-width provisions stay professional_review_required-class output (M5-T039 orchestrator ruling; G6 legal queue).

CONTRACT PRESERVATION (binding): the rule_evaluation contract v1.1.0 is CLOSED for this packet - no schema copy, no generated TS, no integration.py/response.py serialization change (none of those files is in allowed_paths). If the existing determination vocabulary or provenance summary cannot honestly carry a named-street outcome, STOP that sub-scope and record the precise gap in your report - never fork a data path or widen the contract in-packet.

DISPLAY CONTRACT (D-073-R006, binding; DB-025 a-c): (a) CalculationEvidence renders the 'Professional review required' status line ONLY when determination_state says so - a confident within/not-within is not mislabeled; (b) DevelopmentLimits AND ReportView gate uniformly on determination_state (today one gates on state, the other on null-FAR, agreeing only via a server invariant); (c) no 'Wide-street conditional FAR' heading over the conservative value in the not-within case. Screen and report keep rendering from the SAME validated document. DRAFT-pending-G6 vocabulary and not_verified_disclaimer assertions unchanged (D-045-R009); never present a reference FAR as the computed result.

TESTS (binding): DB-023 regressions (a crafted snapshot flipping a qualified row to matched_override is REFUSED; malformed block fails closed at construction, never a KeyError at match(); MatchResult.reason reprs bounded); DB-025(d) multi-page DB-020 fixture (a page-2 segment carries page-2's raw digest, not page-1's); DB-021(e) branch coverage; the wiring truth table (all-NOT_MATCHED resolved -> attested; any MATCHED_OVERRIDE -> professional review + override provenance; any INDETERMINATE or missing input -> refusal unchanged); display cases per DB-025(a-c) incl. the shared screen/report fixture. Keep every suite green at every checkpoint.

Discovery routing (D-069): surface out-of-scope findings in your report; never fix them in-packet. Do not propose WebFetch (network is default-deny). Do not run or document npm/npx/node (web behavior proves ONLY in CI on the pushed head). Run ruff from services/api cwd before every checkpoint (api CI job step 1). Every checkpoint carries IMPLEMENTATION.
